metadata.title: Retro Diner Surrealism
useCases: Editorial food photography with a kitsch twist

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a central figure in retro attire surrounded by a dense, surrealist arrangement of colorful food on a stark white background.
excludeWhen: dark or moody atmospheres are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered female figure in a white and red retro waitress uniform stands behind a table overflowing with a chaotic, colorful mix of meats and candies. The scene is set against a pure white, shadowless background, emphasizing the vibrant, saturated colors of the props and the bold, distressed red typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure as the vertical axis
High-contrast relationship between red accents and white background
Juxtaposition of savory meats and sugary sweets

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The waitress is centered, medium shot, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The waitress's face and the red book she holds serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top bold text, moves down to the subject's face, then fans out across the dense food arrangement in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the area surrounding the subject are stark white, providing breathing room for the busy foreground.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Red (typography, uniform trim, and key food items)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multicolor (pastels and brights from candies and garnishes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value; colors are vivid and bright without deep shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Distressed, stamp-like texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is a perfect circle
The 'M' has a deep middle vertex reaching the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the heavy display sans with a secondary script or serif on props (like the book) for a vintage editorial feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and circular 'O' shapes.
Captures the wide, mid-century technical feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a woman in a 1950s white waitress uniform with red trim, holding a red book, standing behind a table crowded with a surreal mix of glazed hams, sausages, donuts, and colorful candies on a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, wide, red uppercase sans-serif text at the top center with a distressed, stamped texture.

verificationChecks: Is the text red and distressed?
Is the food arrangement a mix of meat and candy?
Is the lighting high-key and shadowless?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the typography
Specific color of the uniform trim
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on food packaging
Exact facial features of the model
postGenerationChecks: No artifacts in the white negative space
Food items look distinct and vibrant
Retro aesthetic is consistent across props and attire
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Retro Character Archetype] + [Surreal Prop Juxtaposition] + [High-Key White Background] + [Distressed Bold Sans-Serif Header].
